text.content:
This system runs the rules for you where it can. The Storyteller is the GM; each player owns one witch (or the guardian).

Setting up

  1. Import the witches, Rook and the threats you need from the Ready-made coven and Threats compendiums (or make new actors: Witch, Guardian or Threat).
  2. Give each player ownership of their witch. Give the guardian to a player only if someone plays it.
  3. Open the Episode Tracker (button at the top of the Actors sidebar, or the hat button in the token controls).
  4. Press Start an episode: pick the difficulty, the threat and the coven. Tick the guardian only if a player plays it. The tracker works out every number from the table, resets Magic, Ward, Hurt and Lives, and applies Scars.

Rolling

Players roll from their sheet. The roll dialog picks the rating and the Difficulty for what you're doing; change them if the Storyteller says so. Tick your Power if it fits (+2 dice; it makes the roll casting), a Surge, your Life, the Book, your own Magic dice, helpers and Sense. The +2 limit is applied for you. Spells and Surges spend your Magic when you roll.

The GM's client reads each roll card and applies it: Clues, potions, damage, lost attacks, Exposure, Hurt, the innocent freed, helpers' Magic. The result is written on the card. To do this by hand instead, turn off Apply roll results automatically in the system settings; each card then gets an Apply button for the GM.

Investigation

Each character takes one action a scene. When everyone has acted, the Storyteller presses End the scene (Doom +1). If Doom reaches the mark, the threat comes to them: the tracker starts a public showdown with the innocent in its grip. With half the Clues, the Storyteller can press Go to it for a hidden showdown. Unanswered Lives cost 1 Magic (or 1 Hurt) when the showdown starts.

Showdown

  • The threat acts rolls a d6 for each attack, picks the target by the rules and posts a card. Each target clicks Defend to roll Nerve against Danger; Hurt is applied. A guardian's owner can click Shield to take the attack instead.
  • In round 1 the threat acts first; after that, the characters act first.
  • End the round applies the innocent's loss in round 1, Exposure for public casting, Doom, a Broken threat fleeing, and the end checks.
  • When the threat is Broken, press The Unmaking: pick the leader and the joiners. Their Magic is spent and the roll is made against the right Difficulty.
  • Use the innocent buttons when someone guards the innocent, and the ± buttons for any correction.

Things you still do by hand

  • Signature moves (the d6 result of 6): the card names the move; apply anything special it does.
  • Shelter, guarding, the Critical's extra die on a next roll, and any ruling the Storyteller makes.
  • Group checks: everyone rolls "Other roll"; the worst roll takes the one cost.
